title: Perioperative hydrocortisone treatment in pancreatoduodenectomy – randomised double-blinded placebo-controlled interventional trial (PD-HYDRA)
official: Perioperative hydrocortisone treatment in pancreatoduodenectomy – randomised double-blinded placebo-controlled interventional trial (PD-HYDRA)
summary: Main objective: 1. to assess the efficacy of the treatment strategy with hydrocortisone infusions in comparison to placebo. Post-operative pancreatic fistula of grade B or worse within 90 days after surgery  (POPF B/C)

interventions.name: HYDROCORTISON Pfizer 100 mg sine Pulver und Lösungsmittel zur Herstellung einer Injektions- oder Infusionslösung

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. 1. Patients with planned elective PD [pancreatoduodenectomy]; regardless of indication
2. 2. Male or female patients aged ≥ 18 years without upper age limit
3. 3. Written informed consent obtained according to international guidelines and local laws
4. 4. Ability to understand the nature of the trial and the trial related procedures and to comply with them
Exclusion criteria:
1. 1. Other perioperatively planned or pre-existing medication with a glucocorticoid in a dose of more than 30mg hydrocortisone-equivalent per day (e.g. for PONV prophylaxis, autoimmune diseases)
2. 18. Focal or generalized epilepsy
3. 19. Untreated overt hypothyroidism (Elevated Thyroid-Stimulating Hormone (TSH) levels and Low Free Thyroxine (FT4) levels)
4. 2. Vaccination with live vaccine or live attenuated vaccine within the 4 weeks prior to surgery
5. 20. Pheochromocytoma
6. 21. Known or persistent abuse of medication, drugs or alcohol
7. 22. Person who is in a relationship of dependence/employment with the sponsor or the investigator
8. 23. Current or planned pregnancy, nursing period
9. 24. For women of childbearing potential failure to use one of the following safe methods of contraception: abstinence from sexual intercourse, female condoms, diaphragm or coil, each used in combination with spermicides; copper intra-uterine device
10. 3. Known hypersensitivity to the IMP (hydrocortisone or any of the excipients)
11. 4. Participation in any other interventional clinical trial within the last 30 days prior to surgery
12. 10. Inherited thromboembolic disease (Factor V Leiden Mutation, Prothrombin gene mutation, Protein C-, Protein S-, or antithrombin deficiency),
13. 5. Simultaneous participation in other interventional trials which could interfere with this trial; simultaneous participation in registries and diagnostic trials is allowed
14. 6. Patient without legal capacity
15. 7. Uncontrolled arterial hypertension ESH Grade 3 (blood pressure remains at or above 180/110 mmHg despite treatment)
16. 8. Chronic heart failure of New York Heart Association (NYHA) class III or IV
17. 9. Glaucoma
18. 25. WOCBP using hormonal contraceptives.
19. 11. Myasthenia gravis
20. 12. Active gastric or duodenal ulcer disease
21. 13. Active diverticulitis
22. 14. Active ulcerative colitis
23. 15. Recent onset (6 months before randomisation) active deep venous thrombosis
24. 16. Recent onset (6 months before randomisation) thromboembolic disease
25. 17. GFR < 30 ml/h/1.73 m² as estimated by CKD-EPI Creatinine Equation (2021) (www.kidney.org/professionals/gfr_calculator)
